confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful unauthorized login, followed by privilege escalation, bulk downloading of sensitive files across multiple departments, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (185.220.101.45) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the suspicious IP (185.220.101.45) following the failed attempts.
Privilege escalation: the user successfully elevated their role to 'admin'.
Data exfiltration: bulk downloading of files across multiple departments (Engineering, Sales, HR, Finance, Marketing) that are outside the user's normal directory scope.
Anti-forensics: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether the IP 185.220.101.45 is a known VPN or proxy used by user_02.
Verification of whether user_02 had an approved emergency maintenance window that would justify off-hours access and log truncation.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_02's account after a series of failed login attempts from an unusual IP address. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin and exfiltrated a large volume of sensitive data from multiple departments before deleting the authentication logs to conceal the activity.
